title: Run CI/CD for millions of repos — on your platform, on Cloudflare
summary: We are moving toward a world in which you can store, build, test, and deploy your code fully on Cloudflare. We built the first piece with Artifacts , versioned code storage that scales to millions of repos. We have stitched the store, build, and deploy steps together with the CI SDK , built on Cloudflare Workflows , so that you can run your continuous integration (CI) pipeline on Cloudflare.
